snippet.title: The Last Bounty Hunter gameplay (PC Game, 1994)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for The Last Bounty Hunter, Dos PC game produced by 1C Company in 1994 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/the-last-bounty-hunter/7804/
A nice action shooter game.Is very interesting because the action takes place in a city full of criminals and everything is like in reality.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
